pages.title: Pocket Kitten
pages.text: Use it on one of your tamed cats and the cat will ride on you, following your adventures from your shoulder.

$(bold)Details$()$(br)Using the bell with an empty hand summons a brand-new tamed cat, already yours, and perches it on you.$(br2)The bell has 16 uses. A car-mounted cat never gets lost, stops creeper ambushes at home, and looks adorable.
